annotations.title: Send a message to a guest

description: Send a message to the guest of a reservation through Smoobu (it goes out on the booking's channel, e.g. the Airbnb or Booking.com inbox, or email). Delivered IMMEDIATELY and cannot be unsent — confirm the text with the user first. Smoobu: POST /api/reservations/{reservationId}/messages/send-message-to-guest.

message_body.description: Message content, HTML or plain text.

name: smoobu_send_message_to_guest
